title: Fully faithful pullback along a field-valued point gives a Galois surjection
statement: Let $X$ be a connected scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $K$ be a field, and let $a:\operatorname{Spec}K\to X$ be a morphism. Choose a separable closure $\Omega/K$ [def-pd-separable-closure] and an algebraic closure $\widetilde\Omega$ of $\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], with the induced $K$-structure. Put $G=\operatorname{Aut}_K(\Omega)$ with its Krull topology, $\bar a:\operatorname{Spec}\widetilde\Omega\to X$, and $\Pi=\pi_1(X,\bar a)$ [def-galois-fibre-functor]. Assume pullback along $a$ is fully faithful on finite etale covers [def-galois-categories]: for every pair $P,Q$ of such covers, $\operatorname{Hom}_X(P,Q)\to\operatorname{Hom}_K(P_K,Q_K)$ is bijective. Each $\sigma\in G$ has a unique $K$-automorphism extension $\widetilde\sigma$ to $\widetilde\Omega$. On every finite etale cover $P$, the rule $t\mapsto t\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\widetilde\sigma)$ on lifts $t:\operatorname{Spec}\widetilde\Omega\to P$ defines a natural fibre-functor automorphism. Restriction along $\operatorname{Spec}\widetilde\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ gives a bijection $|P_{\bar a}|\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,P_K)$ that is $G$-equivariant for the action $s\mapsto s\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma)$ on the target; thus a subgroup of $G$ acts trivially on $|P_{\bar a}|$ exactly when it acts trivially on $\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,P_K)$. These automorphisms define a continuous surjective homomorphism $q_a:G\to\Pi$, equal to the fundamental-group homomorphism induced by $a$ under the field Galois identification. Both $G$ and $\Pi$ are profinite. For every finite etale $P\to X$, restriction and evaluation give bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_X(X,P)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}K,P_K)\simeq |P_{\bar a}|^G$, where the superscript means points fixed by every element of $G$ acting through $q_a$.

source.place: Tag 0BQM, proposition-normal, surjectivity via full faithfulness; Tag 0BNE, lemma-fundamental-group-Galois-group, and Remark 0BQ9, remark-variance. General fully faithful field-point form of the same argument.

proof.text: Apply [lem-dl-a1-field-galois-fibre-identification] over $K$, writing $s:\operatorname{Spec}\widetilde\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}K$. It gives the unique extensions $\widetilde\sigma$, the profinite group $G$, the topological isomorphism $j:G\to\pi_1(\operatorname{Spec}K,s)$, and the natural equivariant bijections $b_{P_K}$. A lift $t$ to $P$ is the same as the pair $(t,s)$ lifting to $P_K$. Thus the inverse of $b_{P_K}$ identifies $|P_{\bar a}|$ with $\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,P_K)$. Its equivariance is exactly the displayed identity for $b_{P_K}$. In particular, a subgroup acts trivially on one set if and only if it acts trivially on the other.

Use [lem-galois-pi1-functoriality] for $a$ and $s$, and set $q_a=a_*\circ j$. Its fibre identification sends a lift $z$ to $\mathrm{pr}_1\circ z$. Hence on $t\in|P_{\bar a}|$ the action is $q_a(\sigma)(t)=t\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\widetilde\sigma)$. Postcomposition by any cover morphism commutes with this rule. Also $\operatorname{Spec}(\widetilde\sigma\widetilde\tau)=\operatorname{Spec}(\widetilde\tau)\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\widetilde\sigma)$, so $q_a(\sigma\tau)(t)=q_a(\sigma)(q_a(\tau)(t))$, and the inverse is given by $\sigma^{-1}$. This proves the natural automorphism and homomorphism claims with the asserted variance. Continuity follows by composition. The target is profinite by [thm-galois-fundamental]; the source is profinite by the field comparison.

The fibre equivalences of [thm-galois-fundamental], for $X$ and for $\operatorname{Spec}K$, together with $j$ and the action identity in step 2 identify $a^*$ with $\operatorname{Res}_{q_a}$. The identifications are natural in covers and their maps; therefore the assumed bijections on cover Hom sets give bijections on Hom sets between all finite continuous $\Pi$-sets (choose covers using essential surjectivity). Thus $\operatorname{Res}_{q_a}$ is fully faithful. Since both groups are profinite and $q_a$ is continuous, [lem-dl-a1-profinite-restriction-full-faithful] gives its surjectivity.

source.place: Tag 0BN6, lemma-functoriality-galois-surjective, equivalence (1)-(2), as used in Tag 0BQM, proposition-normal.

proof.text: Apply the assumed full faithfulness to the covers $X$ and $P$. Since $X_K=\operatorname{Spec}K$, this gives the first section bijection. Under [thm-galois-fundamental] for $\operatorname{Spec}K$, the identity cover has singleton fibre and $P_K$ has fibre $|P_{\bar a}|$. An equivariant map from a singleton is precisely the choice of a fixed point. Via $j$ this is $|P_{\bar a}|^G$, proving the second bijection. Its evaluation map sends a section $u$ to $u\circ s$, which corresponds under the first-projection fibre identification to the claimed lift of $\bar a$.
